newsitem.title: USA: Igene Biotechnology names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Igene Biotechnology names new CEO.

text.p: Igene Biotechnology Inc said Wednesday it has named Ramin Abrishamian chief executive officer.
The position had been vacant since the end of 1996, following the departure of former CEO Dexter Gaston, a company spokesman said. Gaston left when his contract was not renewed.
The board did not appoint an interim chief executive, the spokesman said.
Before joining Igene, Abrishamian had been a consultant assisting companies with their technology and product commercialization, the company said.
